description: This file declares an interface for PKI entity management, including functions for importing/exporting PKCS12 structures, creating self-signed certificates, and setting issued certificates. It is part of a cryptographic library related to ASN.1 and PKI.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntityImportPKCS12
methods.description: Imports a PKCS12 structure into the PKI entity, using provided encoding, length, and password.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntityExportPKCS12Handle
methods.description: Exports the PKI entity as a PKCS12 handle with specified password, optionally including CA certificates.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntityExportPKCS12Encoding
methods.description: Exports the PKCS12 structure as raw encoding, with password and CA inclusion options, returning the encoding and its length.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntityCreateSelfSignedCertEncoding
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate and returns its encoding along with its length.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntityCreateSelfSignedCert
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate object, returning a handle.

methods.name: AdvPKIEntitySetIssuedPKCS7Certs
methods.description: Sets issued PKCS7 certificates for the entity using encoded certificates.
